title: Kimi Code Marketplace Manifest
description: Marketplace catalog for the current Kimi CLI (kimi-code). The default catalog is https://code.kimi.com/kimi-code/plugins/marketplace.json, overridable with the KIMI_CODE_PLUGIN_MARKETPLACE_URL environment variable or /plugins marketplace <source>. Authored from MoonshotAI's official source; Kimi publishes no JSON Schema.
$comment: Provenance: authored (not upstream-vendored) 2026-09-08. Sources: MoonshotAI/kimi-code docs/en/customization/plugins.md and packages/agent-core-v2/src/app/plugin/marketplace.ts. Relative sources resolve against the marketplace URL when remote, or against the marketplace file's directory when local. The legacy kimi-cli has no marketplace.

version.description: Used for update checks via semantic version comparison.

source.description: Plugin location. Aliases url and downloadUrl are accepted; the first non-empty value wins.

displayName.description: Falls back to name, then id. Alias name is accepted.

version.description: Derived from a GitHub tree, commit, or releases/tag URL when present.

type.description: plugin; legacy aliases managed and guide are accepted.

builtIn.description: Declared in the TypeScript interface but not read by the parser.
